title: Lua Patterns
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of lua Patterns and the key behavior described in this lesson.

content.intro: Lua patterns use a compact, language-specific pattern syntax. They do not support every construct found in full regular-expression engines.

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Lua Patterns with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.
